# CURATED. Web Studios

> CURATED. Web Studios designs and builds websites for creative businesses and artists, built by someone with 16 years of experience in sales and e-commerce. Every site is designed to build credibility, communicate value clearly, and turn visitors into enquiries, clients and sales.

CURATED. Web Studios is part of The Curated Art Group Ltd, registered in England & Wales (Company No. 16452804).

## Services

- [One Page Portfolio](https://curatedwebstudios.com/one-page-portfolio.html): A single scrolling page with portfolio, about and enquiry form. From £199, live in days.
- [Bespoke Website (The Full Build)](https://curatedwebstudios.com/bespoke-website.html): A complete website with up to 10 individual work pages, buy links, a catalogue PDF and a launch strategy session. From £499.
- [For Galleries & Institutions](https://curatedwebstudios.com/for-galleries.html): Bespoke gallery websites with roster pages, exhibitions and an enquiry system built for curators, press and collectors. From £1,995, plus optional Management from £195/month.
- [Website Audit](https://curatedwebstudios.com/audit.html): A recorded review of an existing website with a prioritised action list. £99, credited in full against a rebuild within 60 days.
- [Hosting & Care](https://curatedwebstudios.com/hosting-and-care.html): Optional ongoing hosting, updates and content changes. £29/month.
- [Curated OPUS](https://curatedwebstudios.com/curated-opus.html): A checkout and provenance system built for art, catalogued and ready to sell from a single record. Coming soon; included free in year one with the Full Build, then £15/month.
